Build a long PIP table from per-group PIP matrices

Source: R/generics.R
as_pip_table.Rd

Helper for implementing pip_table() methods.

Usage

as_pip_table(pip_list, varnames = NULL, groupnames = NULL)

Arguments

pip_list

A list of K symmetric p x p PIP matrices (one per group; repeat the same matrix if the PIP is shared across groups).

varnames

Optional variable names; defaults to the dimnames of the first matrix, then V1, ..., Vp.

groupnames

Optional group names; defaults to names(pip_list), then Group_1, ..., Group_K.

Value

A data frame in the format described in pip_table().

Examples

m <- matrix(c(0, .9, .1, .9, 0, .4, .1, .4, 0), 3, 3)
as_pip_table(list(A = m, B = m))
#>   i j node1 node2 group pip
#> 1 1 2    V1    V2     A 0.9
#> 2 1 3    V1    V3     A 0.1
#> 3 2 3    V2    V3     A 0.4
#> 4 1 2    V1    V2     B 0.9
#> 5 1 3    V1    V3     B 0.1
#> 6 2 3    V2    V3     B 0.4
